# Shramko Motor Autostart

> Betaflight 2025.12.1 firmware module plus a browser configurator (https://autostart.flyreelstudio.eu) by Andrii Shramko that turns a flight controller into a standalone motor / ESC driver: plug in the battery and the motor starts by itself - wait, smooth linear speed-up, then it holds the power (optionally with random gusts, a set run time and a LiPo battery stop) - no transmitter, receiver or switch. The configurator talks to the board over USB with Web Serial, in the visitor's browser. Open source, GPL-3.0-or-later: https://github.com/AndriiShramko/shramko-betaflight-motor-autostart

## The page, in task order
- Step 1 - Put the firmware on the board: the ready .hex for the HGLRC F405 8S V2 (Betaflight board_name HGLRC_F405_S8), flashed with https://app.betaflight.com -> Firmware Flasher -> Load Firmware [Local]. Windows "DFU device not found": ImpulseRC Driver Fixer or Zadig (WinUSB). Other Betaflight boards: an AI agent follows AGENT_PORTING.md (https://github.com/AndriiShramko/shramko-betaflight-motor-autostart/blob/main/AGENT_PORTING.md): tools/make_board_config.py builds the board's config with the author's reference settings, Docker builds the .hex, tools/check_reference.py proves the board matches. A config with only #define USE_AUTOSTART starts with the program OFF. Going back: the release's ..._stock.hex.
- Step 2 - Connect the board: Chrome/Edge over USB, propeller off. Shows the board, the firmware level and the Motor status (state in plain words, Power %, Battery V, every battery warning, Run the program..., a fixed STOP bar).
- Step 3 - Choose what it does: the program in words ("What the board will do"), five questions (Wait before start, Power, How long, Random gusts, Battery) and one "More settings" drawer with everything else; Save to board writes only the changes, restarts the board and reads every value back.
- Zero clicks for the factory program: 10 s after the battery is plugged in, 10 s speed-up to 15 %, run until the battery stays below 19.8 V (6 x 3.30 V) for 5 s.

## Plain words on the page = Betaflight CLI names (docs/settings.md)
- What starts the motor = autostart_mode (POWER battery plugged in / BUTTON / OFF)
- Wait before start = autostart_delay (s, 0-600; never sooner than 3 s after the ESC gets power)
- Speed-up time = autostart_ramp (0.1 s)
- Power = autostart_throttle (%); Maximum power = autostart_throttle_limit (%)
- How long = autostart_run_time (s; 0 = until the battery stop or power off)
- Random gusts = autostart_pattern STEADY/GUSTS; gust details = autostart_gust_min/_max (%; a peak below Power is raised to Power), _len_min/_max (ms), _pause_min/_max (0.1 s)
- Battery = autostart_cells (0 = Betaflight guesses); stop voltage per cell = autostart_cell_cutoff (0.01 V; 0 = no battery protection; 1-249 count as 2.50 V); wait before the battery stop = autostart_cutoff_time (s)
- Battery counts as plugged in from = autostart_vbat_min (0.1 V); RC switch = autostart_box (40-43 = USER1-4; on HGLRC_F405_S8 USER1/USER2 also switch PINIO1/2, use USER3/USER4); motor outputs = autostart_motors (bitmask); with a computer connected = autostart_usb_inhibit; voltage scale = vbat_scale

## Firmware 1.1 behaviour the page follows
- States (debug_mode AUTOSTART, debug[0]): 0 IDLE, 1 DELAY, 2 RAMP, 3 RUN, 4 DONE (run time over), 5 LOW_BATTERY (battery stop).
- Held by the computer: opening the settings (CLI), STOP (MSP_SET_MOTOR) or the Configurator Motors tab hold the program - nothing starts by itself, not even on a battery re-plug, until the board restarts (Run the program, a save, or USB and the battery off and on). debug[4] bit 64 shows it.
- The battery stop counts in DELAY, RAMP and RUN, from 3 s after the battery appeared; after it only a new battery starts the program again. The RC switch starts the program only from IDLE: after the run time turn it off and on.
- debug[2] (ms in state / 10) is unsigned and stops at 655.35 s; debug[3] (uptime) stops at 3276.7 s; the "implausible voltage" flag (bit 32) is hidden for the first 3 s after the battery appeared.

## ESC telemetry
- Recommended: the ESC's TX pad on the cable's yellow (R, UART5) + feature ESC_SENSOR: the page shows the ESC's voltage, rpm and temperature and calibrates vbat_scale without a multimeter. On the HGLRC F405 8S V2 the R pin of both 8-pin connectors is the same input.
- After a board restart the ESC sends over the TX wire only once the motor has turned; until then MSP keeps the last value, so the page never offers an ESC voltage that is not fresh or does not fit the cell count. TX-wire samples are sparse (some are empty): the page holds an answer for 3 s.
- Bidirectional DShot (dshot_bidir ON, BLHeli_32 32.10+) also works, but a BLHeli_32 that stays on the battery while the board restarts (USB bench) can lock and only beep: replug the battery after a Save or Run.

## Numbers
- Measured on hardware: the speed-up starts 10.01 s after power-on, takes 10.02 s, max deviation from a straight line 1 us.
- Firmware: 76 unit tests (one of them a randomized property test).

## Browsers
- Chrome, Edge, Opera on Windows/macOS/Linux (Web Serial). Firefox 151+ (one-time site permission). Android: Chrome 148+ with USB-OTG, only on phones whose Android supports USB serial. iPhone/iPad: not possible (no Web Serial / WebUSB in iOS browsers).

## Safety
- Remove the propeller; never more than 8S on the board's B pin; the cable's red carries battery voltage - insulate every unused wire separately; ground use only.
